items.title_en: Oil near $100 adds to the squeeze on leveraged private credit borrowers
items.title_zh: 油价逼近 100 美元，加重杠杆型私募信贷借款人压力

items.title_en: PennyMac brings a $364m prime RMBS with its largest collateral pool of the year
items.title_zh: PennyMac 发行 3.64 亿美元优质 RMBS，为年内最大资产池
items.summary_en: PMT Loan Trust 2026-J6 will issue about $363.6 million of residential mortgage-backed securities supported by first-lien, fixed-rate prime mortgages. The pool holds 294 loans, the largest the platform has issued this year, with its highest share of conforming loans at 45.1%, according to Morningstar DBRS. The class A notes are expected to pay 6.00% on the A1 tranche, 5.50% on the A2 and 5.00% on the A33. PennyMac Corp originated the loans and is the deal sponsor, seller and servicer; borrowers have weighted-average annual income of $595,649.
items.summary_zh: PMT Loan Trust 2026-J6 将发行约 3.636 亿美元住房抵押贷款支持证券，底层资产为第一留置权固定利率优质抵押贷款。据 Morningstar DBRS，该资产池包含 294 笔贷款，为该平台今年最大，符合标准贷款占比 45.1%，亦为年内最高。A 类票据中，A1 档预计票息 6.00%，A2 档 5.50%，A33 档 5.00%。PennyMac Corp 为贷款发起方，并担任交易发起人、卖方与服务机构；借款人加权平均年收入为 595,649 美元。

items.title_en: Downing adds a £500m funding line and a head of commercial real estate lending
items.title_zh: Downing 新增 5 亿英镑融资额度并任命商业地产贷款主管
items.summary_en: Downing has launched a £500 million institutional funding line to increase deployment capacity on its private credit platform, and appointed George Cotterell as partner and head of commercial real estate lending; he previously worked at Venn Partners and ESR Europe. The £2.6 billion firm has committed £1.5 billion to private credit transactions since 2010, lending across residential and commercial real estate and structured credit.
items.summary_zh: Downing 启动了一条 5 亿英镑的机构融资额度，以扩大其私募信贷平台的投放能力，同时任命 George Cotterell 为合伙人兼商业地产贷款主管，其此前任职于 Venn Partners 与 ESR Europe。这家管理规模 26 亿英镑的机构自 2010 年以来已向私募信贷交易投入 15 亿英镑，放贷范围涵盖住宅与商业地产以及结构性信贷。
